payload.name: Ambush at the Drain Center-Point
payload.situation: In the flooded Undercity sewers, Rael's wardens spring an ambush as the party closes on the arcane drain that samples signatures.
payload.objective: Protect the witness Mavar Crispin and disable the drain conduit.
combatants: a hexer channeling from the far platform (controller — must be reached)
a caged construct that activates if the conduit is left running
payload.terrain: Narrow walkways over rising sewer-water (fall = swept away), a chokepoint grate, and the conduit itself as an interactable objective.
payload.twist: The water rises each round — the longer the fight, the more the walkways flood, forcing the party toward the objective.
payload.stakes: If Mavar falls or the conduit runs a full survey, the Registry Engine completes its Lower City phase.
